identitySignals: Name '2coachu' (EIN 83-4358319) is registered as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit in Oakland, CA on ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer; the name matches the agenda's '2COACHU' and is highly distinctive

OUSD's own 'Sports Providers & Community Partners' page (YES! Sports, elementary school sports) lists 2CoachU with website https://www.2coachu.net, matching OUSD's 'After-school & summer programs' / Expanded Learning Elementary Sports Program contracts

2coachu.net describes youth academic and athletic programs for K-5 students and shows OUSD YES! Sports Expo imagery, matching the agenda's Community Schools and Student Services / Expanded Learning contracts
research.notes: Agenda gives El Cerrito, CA but the IRS/ProPublica registry lists Oakland, CA and the website says it is Oakland based; the two cities are neighbors and the org serves OUSD schools. No street address, CA entity number or UEI found, so left null.

profile.summary: 2COACHU is a nonprofit youth development organization in the Oakland area. It runs after-school baseball programs, one-day clinics and private instruction for elementary-age students. It says its goal is to narrow the opportunity gap by supporting academic, athletic and social-emotional growth in K-5 students.

sources.title: Sports Providers & Community Partners - Oakland Unified School District

review.notes: The distinctive name 2COACHU appears on OUSD's own YES! Sports provider page, and the website describes K-5 baseball after-school programs, which fits the Expanded Learning contracts. ProPublica shows a 501(c)(3) at EIN 83-4358319 in Oakland. The agenda says El Cerrito, which is a neighboring city and likely a mailing or contact address. Summary, phone, email and website are all supported by the cited pages.
